correctness.rationale: A prefix-normal word beginning in one is characterized exactly by minimal leading spans of every block of consecutive ones. The seven inter-one gaps of an eight-one palindrome are (a,b,c,d,c,b,a); reducing all six nontrivial lengths yields only \(a\le b,c,d\) and \(a+b\le c+d\). The exact substitution converts this to a four-dimensional nonnegative sum with \(x\le y+v\); a complementary geometric-product subtraction proves the rational generating function. Pole orders at all roots of unity imply the cubic asymptotic and the \(n^{-1}\) conditional probability. Independent brute-force palindrome checks \(n=8,\ldots,24\), 4,096 gap comparisons and integer-coefficient checks \(n=8,\ldots,120\) all pass, but are not treated as proofs of infinite scope.

value.rationale: The exact composition-eight layer refines the actively studied but still incompletely enumerated prefix-normal palindrome family. Eight ones introduce the first mirrored gap configuration with a coupled middle-span obstruction; this yields a complete nontrivial constrained-partition series and a sharp \(40/(21n)\) rare-event probability, relevant to prefix-normal and jumbled-matching benchmarks. It is not a claim of unrestricted counting, and the value depends on the natural fixed-composition and palindrome intersection rather than arbitrary parameters.
